@pcbeingused333 ## Verdict > [!NOTE] > **Ready apart from two missing tests.** Merge confidence 4 / 5. > Nothing fails if the guard starts deleting the branch of an open PR, or if `isBranchAncestorOfBase` throws on a missing base. ## Findings | # | Severity | Finding | Certainty | Where | |:---:|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Minor | No test keeps the branch of an open PR | Confirmed | [`branch/index.ts:693`](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/e5c21a0e77743794866626c5da6dd2dbce6a29e8/lib/workers/repository/update/branch/index.ts#L693) | | 2 | Minor | No test covers a missing base branch | Confirmed | [`git/index.ts:995`](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/blob/e5c21a0e77743794866626c5da6dd2dbce6a29e8/lib/util/git/index.ts#L995) |
1. No test keeps the branch of an open PR · Minor · Tests · Confirmed #### What goes wrong The guard skips the deletion when a PR is open, as its comment says, but no test covers that half. If `!branchPr` is lost in a later change, Renovate deletes the head branch of an open PR whose commits are already in the base, the platform closes the PR, and every test still passes. #### Proof With `!branchPr` removed from the condition, all 140 tests of `lib/workers/repository/update/branch/index.spec.ts` pass: ``` - if (!commitSha && !branchPr) { + if (!commitSha) { Test Files 1 passed (1) Tests 140 passed (140) ``` #### Fix A test next to `deletes a reused branch that is already in the base instead of opening an empty PR`. It passes at `e5c21a0e7` and fails with the mutation above (`expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`). It still needs `prettier`: ```ts it('keeps a branch that is already in the base while its PR is open', async () => { scm.branchExists.mockResolvedValue(true); scm.isBranchModified.mockResolvedValue(false); scm.isBranchAncestorOfBase.mockResolvedValue(true); platform.getBranchPr.mockResolvedValueOnce(partial({ number: 5, state: 'open' })); prWorker.ensurePr.mockResolvedValueOnce({ type: 'without-pr', prBlockedBy: 'AwaitingTests' }); await branchWorker.processBranch({ ...config, reuseExistingBranch: true, cacheFingerprintMatch: 'matched' }); expect(scm.deleteBranch).not.toHaveBeenCalled(); expect(prWorker.ensurePr).toHaveBeenCalledOnce(); }); ```
2. No test covers a missing base branch · Minor · Tests · Confirmed #### What goes wrong The docstring of `isBranchAncestorOfBase` says "False when either ref is missing", but the tests cover only a missing branch. Without the `!baseBranchSha` check, the function runs `git rev-list --count null..` and throws instead of returning `false`, and no test notices. #### Proof With `!baseBranchSha` removed, the only failure in `lib/util/git/index.spec.ts` is `excludes the origin/HEAD symbolic ref`, which also fails without this PR on my `git 2.39.5` and passes in CI: ``` - if (!baseBranchSha || !branchSha) { + if (!branchSha) { Test Files 1 failed (1) Tests 1 failed | 148 passed (149) ``` #### Fix A test next to `returns false when the branch does not exist`. It passes at `e5c21a0e7` and fails with the mutation above (`promise rejected "Error: fatal: ambiguous argument 'null..e… { …(2) }" instead of resolving`): ```ts it('returns false when the base branch does not exist', async () => { await expect( git.isBranchAncestorOfBase('renovate/past_branch', 'not_found'), ).resolves.toBeFalse(); }); ```
## What was checked
At e5c21a0e7, 8 checks, 3 not checked | Check | Result | |---|---| | `lib/util/git/index.spec.ts`, `lib/workers/repository/update/branch/index.spec.ts` | 288 pass, and 1 also fails without this PR (`origin/HEAD`, local `git 2.39.5`) | | CI at the tip | 48 checks pass, `license/cla` pending | | Merge into `main` | clean, 294 commits behind | | Mutants of the new code | 9 run: 6 red, 1 equivalent (dropping `!commitSha`), 2 green (findings 1 and 2) | | Delete and recreate loop | none: a deleted branch returns `no-work` on the next run, a recreated one has a commit | | Swallowed errors in the caller's `catch` | safe: `syncGit()` is a no-op by then, so only a local `git rev-list` can fail, and the fallback opens the PR as before | | Closed PR with the same title | untouched: `prAlreadyExisted` runs first | | Other platforms | `GithubScm` and `GerritScm` inherit the method, `LocalFs` returns `false` | ### Not checked - The full suite and the coverage gate ran only in CI. - No run of the built CLI against a real GitLab repository with a stale branch. - Collisions with other open PRs.
